source.surface: minimal integration permission grant, two scopes listed, not yet agreed
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid red-orange fill with a white label — the product's own brand hue, not a semantic green
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Cancel, a pale grey filled control of equal size with a dark label
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: no card and no border; the scope list sits directly on the page background with no tint at all
decisionColour.verdict: Proof that the accept colour is brand-relative rather than semantic. Here the committing control is RED, a hue that in a diff surface would mean deletion and in an error surface would mean failure. Any check that tries to detect acceptance styling by hue would both miss this and misfire elsewhere; what identifies the decision control is that it is the only element carrying a saturated solid fill.
